'''Uedar''' was the only [[moon]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], which was part of the [[Ueda system]] in the [[unincorporated Bosphian provinces]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and [[New Territories]]<ref name="New Territories" /> in square Q-3 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> it was visible in the cloudy [[Local day|daytime]] sky over Ueda when the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|arrived]] outside [[Point Ueda]] [[city]] on Ueda.<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Uedar appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> It was then identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
